page.overview:
Who is Spider-Gwen?

Spider-Gwen is an alternate Gwen Stacy who wears the spider mantle in the Spider-Verse, distinct from Peter Parker's fallen love.

Also known as: Ghost-Spider, Gwenom, Spider-Woman Gwen.
